scenes.name: scene-01.png
scenes.title: From learning to opportunity
scenes.caption: OpportunityGap helps students connect internship requirements to evidence from their CV and projects, then choose a practical next step. No hiring score is provided.

scenes.name: scene-02.png
scenes.title: Guided Demo is the recommended start
scenes.caption: This workflow uses a synthetic student profile and deterministic results. Our four-response survey is preliminary evidence, not representative research or proof of demand.

scenes.name: scene-03.png
scenes.title: Inspect the synthetic CV and role
scenes.caption: Alex describes HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Git and collaboration, but explicitly says they have not written automated tests. The role also includes degree and experience requirements.

scenes.name: scene-04.png
scenes.title: Keep personal contribution visible
scenes.caption: Optional evidence describes what the student actually built. Inputs are not automatically saved. Guided Demo accepts this sample only; edited text cannot silently receive a sample assessment.

scenes.name: scene-05.png
scenes.title: Evidence you can inspect
scenes.caption: Every requirement has an exact role excerpt. Supported assessments cite the student's supplied evidence. Support is self-reported, not independently verified proficiency.

scenes.name: scene-06.png
scenes.title: Explicit gaps need explicit evidence
scenes.caption: Testing is an explicit gap because the CV says: I have not written automated tests yet. Missing information alone would be classified as needing clarification.

scenes.name: scene-07.png
scenes.title: Eligibility stays separate from skills
scenes.caption: A degree in progress is not a completed degree. Professional experience and twenty-hour availability are unstated. A practice project cannot replace these requirements.

scenes.name: scene-08.png
scenes.title: One practical next action
scenes.caption: Build a tested task planner: practise testing, R3, using existing interface and Git experience, R1 and R2. The deliverable is a small repository with tests for real task behaviours.

scenes.name: scene-09.png
scenes.title: A concrete definition of completion
scenes.caption: Build the task form, subject filter and completion control. Test the three behaviours and an empty task error. Run the tests and record actual results in the README.

scenes.name: scene-10.png
scenes.title: Turn learning into portfolio evidence
scenes.caption: Capture the problem, approach, screenshots or test results, and your personal contribution. OpportunityGap provides a checklist; it has not fetched or inspected a GitHub repository.

scenes.name: scene-11.png
scenes.title: Truthful CV wording
scenes.caption: Current rewrites cite existing experience. Proposed project wording is separate and marked use only after completion. Do not invent achievements, tools, credentials or metrics.

scenes.name: scene-12.png
scenes.title: A plan you can keep
scenes.caption: The real downloaded text file includes comparisons, evidence, checklists, CV wording and clarifications. It can be read offline once saved; the website is not an offline app.

scenes.name: scene-13.png
scenes.title: Desktop and mobile
scenes.caption: The production browser checks pass at 1280px and 390px. The mobile view shown here is captured from the working app. Accessibility and student usability evaluation remain ongoing work.

scenes.name: scene-14.png
scenes.title: Live AI is implemented, not verified working access
scenes.caption: Live analysis requires provider configuration, credits and explicit consent. Model quality and retention are unverified. The capstone uses Guided Demo; failed AI never becomes a synthetic result silently.

scenes.name: scene-15.png
scenes.title: A reviewable capstone
scenes.caption: The owner supplied the learner problem, research and constraints; Codex helped implement and validate the app. No hiring outcomes or time savings are claimed. Review the final branch and video before submission.
